name: Burrow Pages
description: Your static websites on your own addresses: from GitHub or GitLab (built in a container when they need it), from an upload, or a site that lives elsewhere. Every push deployed, any deploy one click from live again, visitor numbers without cookies, health checks, and your login, a password or public for each.
author: Alexd Aero

actions.label: Pause every site
actions.confirm: Every site stops answering until you resume it. Nothing is deleted.

settings.label: GitHub app client ID
settings.help: The GitHub OAuth app “Sign in with a code” uses (device flow). Burrow Pages' own is filled in; its client ID is public and there is no secret. Burrow Pages → Settings can override it too.

update_card.title: {name} {version}
update_card.tagline: Rebuilt from scratch: a dashboard of its own, builds, uploads, rollbacks, analytics and public sites.
highlights: Its own dashboard at /__gate/pages, on phones too, with live deploy logs
Vite, Astro, Next, Hugo, Jekyll… built in a locked-down container; GitLab tokens
Upload a folder or a .zip; proxy any site with caching that rides out outages
Every deploy kept for a one-click rollback; redirects, headers, SPA mode, maintenance
Visitor numbers without cookies, health checks, and public sites behind the shield
